objective: Count the total available units of a specific Uvex work glove product (size L, color Blue) across all Vienna PowerTool branches today.

params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants WHERE brand='Uvex' AND series='Uvex Industrial' AND model='uvex 2KV-937 Work Gloves' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku=product_variants.product_sku AND property_key='Size' AND property_value_text='L') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties WHERE product_sku=product_variants.product_sku AND property_key='Color Family' AND property_value_text='Blue')
params.vienna_stores: select store_id from stores where city='Vienna' and is_open=1
params.count: sum of available_today_quantity from store_inventory where store_id in ($vienna_stores) and product_sku = $product_sku
